blurb: Flow Yoga & Wellness offers yoga, Pilates, senior yoga, massage therapy, infrared sauna sessions, workshops, sound baths, and private wellness parties. The studio provides a serene space for mindful movement and wellness practices. They also host community meditation gatherings and special events with guest teachers.
extraNote: RSVP or pre-registration required for workshops and events · Chair massage $20 for 10 minutes · Back entrance on Arboleda Street (Next to Java Station) due to roadwork on Hollister and driveway access issues.
